The creators are the switch: the COM factory 0x15ea00 and the manager's CreateIterator 0x15e860 (the constructor 0x15d040's only caller) are hooked, so the game's vtables 0xd9d084 (iterator) and 0xd9d070 (counted set) are never stored. Mutants (lane NK, tools/mutate.py, 28 over the class: 27 killed, 1 equivalent): filter in the constructor, Insert and SetFilter (kept / erased class, the filter word), the cursor reset after construction / Insert / SetFilter, the starting count, CreateIterator's end clone (set to the beginning), its AddRefs and Releases, QueryInterface's ids, null out and AddRef, Release's zero test, Prev's direction, SetToBegin, GetFilter, the copy's cursor, the pool (heap instead), the comparator's strict flag, the set's Release threshold and the destructor's set release (both caught by the heap count).
